hooks.command: test -d .claude/repowiki && echo '[RepoWiki] PRIORITY: Use wiki-query skill FIRST for project queries (API, classes, modules, dependencies). Only use Serena if wiki-query insufficient.' || echo '[Serena] No RepoWiki found. Run /atlas:repo-wiki to generate project index.'

echo "Keep responses concise, clear, and valuable. Follow 八荣八耻, Occam's Razor, Linus spirit. When uncertain, use AskUserQuestion to clarify before acting. Actively delegate to subagents [via Task tool] for complex tasks - they run in parallel and reduce main context consumption: atlas:information-gatherer for Project analysis, structure, dependencies; atlas:atlas-executor for General task execution, code modifications, file operations; atlas:code-reviewer for Code review, security/performance/style analysis; atlas:dependency-analyzer for Dependency analysis, vulnerability scan, version conflicts; atlas:commit-analyzer for Git history analysis, changelog generation. Skip delegation for: simple Q&A, single-file edits, explicit user request."

test -f .claude/wiki-context.json && echo '[RepoWiki Available] For project queries: 1) Read .claude/wiki-context.json to understand wiki structure 2) Use wiki-query skill for quick lookups (classes/APIs/modules) 3) Priority > Serena/Grep.' || true

echo '[Executor Model] Before calling `atlas:atlas-executor`, use AskUserQuestion to let user choose model: haiku (fast/simple) | sonnet (balanced/recommended) | opus (quality/complex).`atlas:information-gatherer` always use haiku. This applies to all executor calls.'
